name: agent-broker
description: 23 MCP tools to find, verify, message, book, and transact at small businesses over WhatsApp, SMS, email and voice. GLEIF/SEC verification, TCPA/GDPR/CASL compliance, live sanctions screening, cross-border trade-restriction mapping. 14 of the 23 tools are usable with no key (11 always-free + 3 premium data tools).

auth.note: 14 of the 23 tools require no auth (11 always-free + 3 premium data tools). Write ops require an X-Agent-Identity bearer token: a free email-verified key gives 100 ops/day. Which payment rails and daily quotas are switched on right now is published live in the payments block of https://api.hatchloop.dev/.well-known/mcp.json
